name: herdrpowers
description: Development framework for herdr: structured skills and workflows with configurable profiles, model/effort targets, TDD, and explicit work and review routes.

interface.shortDescription: Herdr multi-pane orchestration for the whole development cycle
interface.longDescription: Plan, implement, test, and review through resolved assignments and optional composition profiles. Separate delegated targets use reset-backed Herdr panes; profile self-target delegation uses fresh subagents, while other owner-session modes permit reported self-review. Covers TDD, debugging, worktrees, verification, and branch integration with explicit lifecycle permission and honest fallback reporting.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build.
Route this task through the appropriate herdr panes.
Let's add a feature to this project.
